subject: Re: Latest news
author: Xandu
body:
I have a few ideas on how we can make this better for everyone. I agree that the forums isn't the best place for news since it is kind of hidden away. I like the idea of a holding area where you can post news and we can then put stuff in the correct place. It also means that we can award points depending on the content that has been contributed... I know that the addiction points are really important to some people.

We will have this on the agenda for our next BurnoutAholics meeting and get back to you with the details 😃

-- The Creator --
